svg.title: Draw it yourself: Week 33
svg.desc: A large empty framed panel with a dashed inner border and faint centre text reading your curve here. The prompt asks the learner to plot the two scores by hand from the printed table, in two colours, mark the peak of the unseen-rows line with a dashed vertical line, and write the sentence about memorising underneath it in their own handwriting.
svg.text: Fifteen depths, two colours, thirty points. Every one of them goes through your eyes.
Dashed vertical line at the peak. Then write it in your own hand: “after here it is memorising”.
